study type: cross-sectional analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: 141 preterm-born young adults with very low birth weight and 32 term-born young adults
finding: Lower urinary alpha-klotho was associated with higher systolic blood pressure, lower urinary angiotensin-(1-7), and higher urinary angiotensin II / angiotensin-(1-7) ratio in preterm-born young adults with very low birth weight
